title: Chapter 43: Mission Complete
html:
Cold water had splashed across his clothes and hair. He sat there shaking, stunned by how real the experience had felt.

It took a while for the dizziness to clear. When he finally steadied himself, the weak candlelight showed an otherwise unchanged bathroom.

I hit something. I know I did.

A fresh mark showed on the rim of the tub.

Was that all I struck? No—the pressure disappeared at exactly the same moment.

Needing an objective account, Chen Ge grabbed the phone that had been recording and replayed the footage from the beginning.

For most of the ritual, the recording showed nothing unusual.

At the appointed moment, Chen Ge’s posture went rigid while the water in the tub began to ripple on its own.

From this angle, it looks much worse than it felt at the start.

While he had been experiencing the ritual, the sequence had seemed almost dreamlike. On video, the stillness of the bathroom made every small movement look ominous.

At first, nothing changed beyond the occasional drip of water and the wavering candle flame.

Then Chen Ge frowned. The recording did not match what he remembered.

The footsteps he had heard were absent. So were the impacts against the door. The microphone had captured only the quiet bathroom, the water, and the faint hiss of the candle.

Were the footsteps and the pounding part of the ritual?

Near the end, the previously calm water began to churn. At the same time, something appeared in the corner of the frame that made Chen Ge’s skin crawl.

A palm-sized mirror fragment beside the tub clouded over as though dark mist had gathered beneath its surface. From that darkness, a human-shaped shadow slowly emerged. Its build and outline resembled He Feng.

On the recording, Chen Ge had already begun to pull away from the ritual when the shadow leaned closer.

Just as he was about to break free, the shadow reached toward him and forced him back into the supernatural trance.

Chen Ge’s body jolted. He struggled against something the camera could barely capture while the shadow flickered like a damaged television image.

At the critical moment, the rag dolls around the tub began to sway despite the still air. The smallest toppled onto the palm-sized mirror fragment and covered it completely.

The shadow blurred at once. Chen Ge’s flailing hand struck the tub, leaving the mark he had noticed afterward, and the dark figure vanished. A heartbeat later, he broke free of the trance.

The recording ended there. Now that he knew what had happened, Chen Ge’s determination to remove the mirror entity only hardened.That thing has to go.

He saved the recording and picked up the small doll lying over the mirror fragment. One of its seams had snagged on the broken glass, and the fabric was soaked through.

They all come from the other side, yet they’re nothing alike. Some only frighten people; others are filled with malice.

Chen Ge dried himself off, changed into dry clothes, and returned all the dolls to his pocket. Only then did he feel his nerves begin to settle.

Breaking mirrors isn’t enough. It can emerge from fragments and disappear again whenever it wants. How am I supposed to fight something I can barely locate?

Out of curiosity, Chen Ge picked up the palm-sized fragment. Water droplets on its surface began to move by themselves, slowly forming a single number: 3.

Is that a threat? Three because of He San, He Feng, and me? Or is it counting down to something?

He had no idea what the number meant, but he doubted it was good news.Keep threatening me. One day I’ll figure out exactly what you are and get you out of my Haunted House for good.

It was the harshest promise he could make while his hands were still trembling from the encounter.

After taking a steadying breath, Chen Ge picked up the black phone. He expected little, but the message on the screen made his eyes widen.

“Specters’ Favored, you endured Deep Water until the required interval was complete. Congratulations on completing the Nightmare Mission! Reward obtained: Yin Yang Vision.

“Yin Yang Vision: See through the boundary that blurs the two worlds. With a Yang body, perceive Yin presences. (Significant enhancement to vision; additional functions currently unknown.)

“Notice: You have completed two Nightmare Daily Missions. Completing a third Nightmare Mission will randomly unlock a Trial Mission for one scenario!

“Three consecutive missions completed with a completion rating above 95 percent. New feature unlocked: My Friends from the Other Side [Affection Status]!”

Chen Ge read the messages twice. He had intended to end the ritual early once it became dangerous, but the mirror entity’s interference had delayed his escape just long enough for the black phone to register a successful completion.

In the narrowest sense, the mirror entity had accidentally helped him complete the mission. Chen Ge still had no intention of thanking it.

Reviewing the notifications, he realized how important this Nightmare Mission had been. Failure would have cost him the reward, delayed the next Trial Mission, and prevented the phone’s newest function from unlocking.

Curiosity winning out, Chen Ge opened the new tab. The interface changed, and five unfamiliar names appeared on the screen.
